text: No. I mean there are two routes. one of them is characters and the other is workspace/characters im asking if you remove the one that is not workspace/* does it break
resolution: Answered the specific routing question: removing the standalone non-workspace /characters route registration and CharactersRoute component should not break the workspace character route, because workspace/characters does not mount CharactersRoute. It would break only if the deletion also removes shared modules under editors/characters that workspace imports, such as preview, paintKit, grabKit, smoothKit, gridData, draft, generate, roster, animPresets, and regions. No code changed.
